newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - TelecomAsia to post profit.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TelecomAsia to post profit.

text.p: Thai fixed line telephone operator, TelecomAsia Plc, is expected to post a profit this year following its unit's sale of shares in a Philippines-based firm, Seamico Securities said on Friday.
"While we previously expected TelecomAsia to record a net loss of 192 million baht ($7.68 million) for 1996, we now expect it to record a small net profit for 1996," Seamico said in a report.
TelecomAsia said on Thursday its wholly-owned unit, Telecom Holding Co Ltd, had sold its 10 percent stake in the Philippines-based Bayan Telecommunications Co Ltd to two investors.
It said Telecom Holding would receive proceeds of 925 million baht from the sales.
Seamico said in the report that TelecomAsia was likely to realise a pre-tax profit of about 250 million baht from the sale. The profit will be recorded in the third quarter results.
TelecomAsia shares were up 0.25 baht at 49.75 by the midday break.
